Agent Name: Assistant
Step Number: 14
Reason for Mistake: The Assistant made a critical calculation error by failing to account for the 2-year-old child in the cost of daily tickets. The family consists of 2 adults, 1 child (age 5), and 1 child (age 2). The Assistant calculated the daily ticket cost for only 3 people (2 adults + 1 child), resulting in $24.75 per visit. It completely omitted the 2-year-old from the calculation. While the 2-year-old likely pays the same rate as the 5-year-old ($8.25), the Assistant's math was based on an incorrect headcount. This led to an underestimation of the daily ticket cost ($74.25 instead of the correct $99.00) and a nonsensical "savings" figure of -$201 (indicating a loss), when in reality, the family would save money by buying the annual pass ($300 vs $198 for daily tickets). The error occurred in the final calculation step where the Assistant synthesized the gathered data.
